name: Garganta la Olla (Spain)
description: Green field with a blue diagonal band edged red from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Garganta la Olla (a gorge between towers, a fleur-de-lis and a cauldron).
history: Municipal flag of Garganta la Olla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
